The '''Imperial skimmer''' was a type of vehicle used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Ugnaught rebellion]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] it was used to attack [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] while he was on a [[Floatboat]], who had just survived a large drop from [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] thanks to [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]].<ref name="msw57" />
